permits.notes: The city's OpenGov portal has no public API; this is its export to ArcGIS, refreshed by the city (last export 2026-10-20). Permits filed after that date are not here yet. Latitude/Longitude in the export are rounded to 44.5/-73.2, so a map needs geocoding of the address. Notable rule: demolition (not interior), ADU, commercial restaurant/bar/cafe or tenant fit-out or change of use, new building or 10+ units, est. cost >= $250,000.

items.project: Relocation of Previously Approved Sauna @ Hula

sales.notes: Vermont property transfer tax returns, posted by the Department of Taxes about a week after closing and published by VCGI. Arm's length = fee-simple transfer, no tax exemption claimed, price above $0. Buyer state is the buyer's mailing address on the return, a proxy for 'out-of-state'. Individual names are not copied.

blotter.notes: The city publishes no daily police log. Press releases arrive by RSS (headline + link kept; bodies can name people, so the column writer applies the arrested-or-charged rule). Incident, arrest and fire exports are monthly, a month behind, and anonymous; the service is re-published each month with a new layer id, which the script discovers.

projects.notes: One record per PROJNAME from the city's construction portal layer (1,800+ street segments). Projects completed or cancelled more than a year ago are dropped. Since You Checked already emits a change line when a segment is edited (scripts/changes/sources/roads.py).
